content.text:
Made two improvements to `0.html`:

- Wrapped the nav in a semantic `<header>` element.
- The theme toggle now stays in sync when the OS-level color scheme changes while no explicit user preference is stored (previously the icon/aria-pressed state would go stale in that case).

The template was already well-built (accessible skip link, scroll-spy nav, dark mode with localStorage persistence, print styles, reduced-motion support). Let me know if you want deeper changes — e.g., real content, additional sections, or a different visual design.
